# Bundled dependency

`signalsmith-linear/fft.h` and `LICENSE.txt` are copied unchanged from the
preserved `research/open-source/signalsmith-linear/` checkpoint. They provide
the native core's FFT; no package download or installation is required.

The research [source manifest](../research/open-source/source-manifest.json)
pins the FFT to Signalsmith Linear commit
`146b26f91b48835d665fa0498d64d9617818d27a`. The MIT notice is retained beside
the header. Copying the small dependency keeps normal native builds independent
of the experimental directory without altering the original evidence.
